review.headline: Tempo session executed as prescribed: 2 km easy, 4 km at threshold pace, 2 km easy, all 8.0 km completed.
observations: Middle 4 km averaged 4:37/km, exactly on the 4:37/km target, with splits of 4:36 to 4:37 held steady for km 3 to 6.
Warm-up and cool-down laps at 5:45/km with HR 135 to 140 stayed in easy territory, consistent with a controlled effort.
Tempo-block HR settled at 161 to 162 and peaked at 165, a steady threshold-type load rather than a surge.
Overall 8.0 km in 2488 s, average 5:11/km, cadence 176 spm.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so the subjective effort of the tempo block is unknown.
